ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels (central field) to 15% low-intensity black pixels (margins and notch area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field with black contiguous pigmentation along the trailing edges and lateral tips. Distinct focal dark circular blobs (mottling) observed: one prominent spot on the left mid-lobe and two smaller spots adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees; deep bounding-box penetration towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serration along the distal two-thirds of the trailing edge; transition to smoother, low-amplitude rounded peaks near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips; anterior edge shows characteristic convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least six roughly circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (pigmentation voids) distributed across both lobes, consistent with healed barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions located in the lower-left quadrant of the fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of sessile barnacle colonization on both distal tips, appearing as textured, three-dimensional, high-contrast brownish-grey protrusions.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint reddish-brown pixel variations visible within the interior of circular scars on the left lobe.
